verses.text: The LORD said to Moses,
"Give the people of Israel this command: When you enter the land of Canaan, this is the land that will be given to you as your own. These are its borders:
Your southern side will include part of the desert of Zin, along the border of Edom. On the east, your southern border will start at the south end of the Dead Sea.
It will turn south of Scorpion Pass, continue on to Zin, and go south of Kadesh Barnea. Then it will go on to Hazar Addar and over to Azmon.
From Azmon it will turn toward the stream on the border of Egypt and end at the Mediterranean Sea.
Your western border will be the coast of the Mediterranean Sea. This will be your border on the west.
For your northern border, draw a line from the Mediterranean Sea to Mount Hor,
and from Mount Hor to the road into Hamath. The border will then go on to Zedad,
continue to Ziphron, and end at Hazar Enan. This will be your border on the north.
For your eastern border, draw a line from Hazar Enan to Shepham.
The border will go down from Shepham to Riblah, on the east side of Ain. From there it will go along the slopes east of Lake Galilee.
Then the border will go down along the Jordan River and end at the Dead Sea. This will be your land, with these borders all around it."
Moses gave the people of Israel this command: "This is the land you will divide among yourselves by casting lots. The LORD has commanded that it be given to the nine and a half tribes.
For the tribes of Reuben and Gad, family by family, and half the tribe of Manasseh have already received their land.
These two and a half tribes have received their land on the east side of the Jordan, across from Jericho, toward the sunrise."
The LORD said to Moses,
"These are the names of the men who will divide the land for you: Eleazar the priest and Joshua son of Nun.
Also choose one leader from each tribe to help divide the land.
These are their names: From the tribe of Judah, Caleb son of Jephunneh.
From the tribe of Simeon, Shemuel son of Ammihud.
From the tribe of Benjamin, Elidad son of Chislon.
From the tribe of Dan, the leader Bukki son of Jogli.
From the sons of Joseph: from the tribe of Manasseh, the leader Hanniel son of Ephod,
and from the tribe of Ephraim, the leader Kemuel son of Shiphtan.
From the tribe of Zebulun, the leader Elizaphan son of Parnach.
From the tribe of Issachar, the leader Paltiel son of Azzan.
From the tribe of Asher, the leader Ahihud son of Shelomi.
From the tribe of Naphtali, the leader Pedahel son of Ammihud."
These are the men the LORD commanded to divide the land of Canaan among the people of Israel.
